sources.title: kela.fi
highlights: When you move to Finland, you can usually qualify for benefits from Kela and a Kela card starting from the day of the move
Working in Finland qualifies you for Kela benefits only if you earn at least EUR 800.02 per month in salary or wages from the work you do in Finland
You must have a bank account so that we can pay your benefits to you

sources.title: kela.fi
highlights: Let us also know that you are moving to Finland with the form Notification - Moving to Finland or employment in Finland Y 77e (PDF
You can apply for a Kela card either on a form or in the OmaKela e-service
Send the form together with any supporting documents to Kela, PL 10, 00056 KELA
You need a Kela card to prove that you have the right to Kela reimbursements when you go see a private doctor or a private dentist who cannot check your information electronically
